trace_quality: deduction points close exactly to max_score minus score
flags or low confidence include attention_note
no trace repeats a downstream consequence of the first material error

before_packet_freeze: Validate the existing development-only human gold privately.
Build new matched image packets from the frozen anonymous snapshot.
Bind the v5.3 prompt, v2 rubric, course specification, output schema, and skill snapshot in packet metadata.
Check M1-to-T1 lineage before any provider call.
before_provider_call: Validate all packet contracts and lineage reports.
Pin the Codex provider/model in private run metadata.
Bind the public DeepSeek release policy and require the stable Flash model.
before_public_reporting: Validate every private output against deduction_trace_v1.
Compute aggregate-only metrics and audit the public record for privacy.
Classify high-impact disagreements before attributing fault.

limitations.en: This historical preflight is superseded and is not a model result. It preserved the v2 rubric before the completed V5.2 Flash analysis; that sequence is no longer authorized for a V5.3 run. Any development result remains a single-course development finding and cannot establish production readiness or teacher replacement.
limitations.zh: 这是已被取代的历史预检，不是模型结果。它在完成 V5.2 Flash 分析前保留了 v2 rubric；该顺序不再获准用于 V5.3 运行。任何开发集结果都只是单课程开发发现，不能证明生产就绪或教师替代。

next_action.en: Do not create a packet from this historical plan. Use the evidence-derived V5.3-r2 rubric candidate after calibration and a separately frozen development gold.
next_action.zh: 不得根据这份历史计划创建 packet。完成校准并单独冻结开发集 gold 后，改用基于证据的 V5.3-r2 rubric 候选。

supersession_reason: The V5.2 Flash analysis showed that V5.3 must first use an evidence-derived detailed rubric; a V5.3 run with the old V5.2 rubric would waste model budget and create an invalid version-comparison narrative.
